demonstrated: Eligible native calls already use stack-backed small arguments and deferred invocation contexts. Bound storage already becomes locals; no unconditional full child frame per helper.

Default JSON numeric conversion is a non-async method returning a completed ValueTask over native UTF-8. Construction is iterative and suspends only for hooks; no per-number async state machine to delete.
PyList already owns its final object[] with explicit count/capacity and replacement preflight; no List<object> wrapper to remove.
Native integral floor division/modulo and direct unpacked helper returns already exist. Do not repeat their original optimization.
hypothesesNotDecisions: Native list storage could avoid numeric boxes, but mutable reads must retain canonical identity across aliases and later mutation. Immutable tuple indirection cannot simply be reused. A uniform wider payload also affects string-heavy CSV and direct array transfers.

Call/record pipeline consolidation still merits inspection, but current profiles do not identify another removable whole stage. Inclusive dispatch/call groups contain useful arithmetic, parsing and indexing.
gateDecision: Two bounded current-source captures and targeted source checks complete. No new runtime prototype justified yet; continue structural call/record design with explicit semantic/storage scope. No permanent design ban, repeated capture, fixed-percentage veto or performance forecast.
